name: Kyouso-sama ni Houshi Shitai!
source:
Driven to the brink by a series of misfortunes, the protagonist finally commits a crime.
Amidst this despair, they encounter a mysterious man who calls himself the "Founder"...

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12767]Novelgame[/url]]
